report:
Oropharynx, right tonsil, tonsillectomy

Received in formalin is a tonsillectomy specimen measuring 40 x 30 x 20 mm. There is an ulcerated tumour in the right tonsil measuring 15 x 12 x 8 mm, 6 mm from the closest (deep) margin. The margins are inked. Representative sections are taken in 8 blocks.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Tonsillectomy
- Tumour site: Palatine tonsil, right
- Tumour size: 15 mm (greatest dimension)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Squamous cell carcinoma, conventional (keratinising)
- Histologic grade: G2, moderately differentiated
- Tumour histology:
  The tumour is a moderately differentiated keratinising squamous cell carcinoma. Infiltrating nests and cords of atypical squamous cells show intercellular bridges and focal keratinisation, with moderate nuclear pleomorphism, in a desmoplastic stroma.
- Tumour extent: No extension beyond the primary site
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- HPV status by p16 immunohistochemistry: Negative

Margins
- Invasive tumour: All margins negative
  - Closest margin: 6 mm (deep)

Additional findings
- None identified

OROPHARYNX, right tonsil, tonsillectomy
- SQUAMOUS CELL CARCINOMA, moderately differentiated, 15 mm; p16 negative;
  completely excised (closest margin 6 mm, deep); see synoptic report

checks.message: p16 is not positive: HPV-independent oropharyngeal carcinoma is staged on the HPV-independent oropharynx and hypopharynx protocol; no pTNM is assigned here.
